about: The back stop for bare hands (milestone-1 task 57, the owner's answers of Oct 8): a guarded stop: from the guarded shuffle's pace to standing in guard in 3 frames (6 rules frames), the trail foot stepping up; keyed as legs and hips only (the grip's guard or block plays above them) from bare hands' fighting stance (CombatIdle01's first frame), each step lifting its foot 16 cm in place, travelling while up and setting it down in place, so the foot lock never drags a planted foot. All the clips of one kind share its length and travel, so the rules hold one profile per kind. Every frame kept as a key pose: Cascadeur's inbetweening would move planted feet. Source frames at 30 fps from 0.
